name: AniList ↔ MAL Sync
description: Bidirectional AniList and MyAnimeList synchronization for anime and manga in Seanime.

notes: AniList ↔ MyAnimeList sync for anime and manga. Includes built-in MAL API client setup (Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URI), PKCE auth-link generation, and full-URL auth-code extraction. Based on nnotwen/MyAnimeListSync (MIT).
